name: adleak
description: Find where your landing page leaks ad budget, then let an AI agent fix it. Verified with Kane CLI.

scripts.audit:demo: node bin/adleak.js audit http://localhost:4321 --budget 50 --expect google_ads,ga4,meta,yandex --ad "Dental implants in 1 day from 150 000 KZT, free 3D scan"
scripts.fix:demo: node bin/adleak.js fix http://localhost:4321 --dir demo/site/public --budget 50 --expect google_ads,ga4,meta,yandex --ad "Dental implants in 1 day from 150 000 KZT, free 3D scan" --context "Lead API: POST /api/lead with JSON {name, phone, utm}. Do not touch tracking IDs in SITE_CONFIG." --headed
